spans.s:
r. 1st and 10th cls. (तोलति तुलति तोलयति-ते or irr. तुलयति)
To weigh or measure.

f. (-ला)
1 Measure by weight.
2 A measure or weight of gold and silver, 100 Palas, or about 145 ounces troy.
3 A balance, especially a fine balance, goldsmith's or assay scales.
4 The sign of the zodiac,

Libra.
5

Resemblance, likeness, equality, similarity.
6 A vessel.
7 Sloping beams or timbers in the roof of a house.
E.
तुल to weigh or to resemble, affixes क and टाप्.

r. 1st cl. (तूलति)
1 To dismiss, to send forth or turn out.
2 To ascertain quantity or weight; some make this a root of the tenth class (तूलयति-ते.)

n. (-लं)
1 The mulberry, (Morus Indica.)
2 Æther, the heaven or atmosphere.
mn. (-लः-लं)
Cotton.
f. (-ला-ली)
The wick of a lamp, or cotton twisted into a similar form for applying unguents, &c.
(-ली)
1

Indigo.
2

A weaver's fibrous stick or brush.
3 A painter's brush, &c. see तुली and तुरी; also तूलि.
E.
तूल to dismiss, to send forth, affix घञ्, fem. affixes टाप् and ङीष्.

ind.
Having weighed, having counterpoised, made equal or like, &c.
E.
तुल to weigh, क्त्वा aff.

f. (-णी)
A quiver.

f. (-सी)
A small shrub held in veneration by the Hindus, Tulasi or holy basil, (Ocymum sanctum.)
E.
तुला resemblance, and षो to destroy, affixes ङ and ङीप्; being unparalleled: this plant is said to be a female metamorphosed.

f. (-टिः-टी)
1 An ornament of the feet or toes.
2 A certain weight.
3 A hundred millions.
E.
तुला a balance, कुट to measure, affix अच् and इ or ङीष्; what is valued by weight, &c. or तुला a measure, &c. and कोटि Crore, or million.

m. (-शः)
A sort of ordeal, in which the accused is tried by being weighed repeatedly in a scale: if he is lighter the second time he is pronounced innocent; if equipoised still, or heavier, he is guilty.
E.
तुला a scale, and कोश ordeal.

m. (-टः)
1 An oar, a paddle.
2 The scale or cup of a balance.
E.
तुला, and धट a scale.

m. (-रः)
The sun.
E.
तुला the sign, and धर who has or possesses.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
A trader, a dealer, trafficking, trading.
m. (-रः)
1 The sign

Libra.
2

The string of a balance.
3 The beam.
E.
तुला the scales, &c. आधार what or who supports.

f. (-क्षा)
Ordeal by the balance, the weight of the accused being first taken, certain prayers and ceremonies are performed, after which he is weighed again: if lighter, he is innocent; if heavy, or as at first, guilty.
E.
तुला, and परीक्षा test.

m. (-षः)
A person weighed in a balance, or an effigy of him used as a weight.
E.
तुला, and पुरुष a man.

n. (-नं)
Gift of gold or valuables of the weight of the donor.
E.
तुलापुरुष, and दान gift.

m. (-हः)
The string of a balance.
E.
तुला, and प्रग्रह holding; also तुलाप्रग्राह.

n. (-नं)
Measure by weight.
E.
तुला, and मान measure.

n. (-जं)
The Gunjā or berry of the Abrus precatorius, from which the goldsmith's or jeweller's weight in India is taken; the berry weighs about 1(5/16) grain troy, the factitious weight about 2(3/16).
E.
तुला weight, and वीज seed.

n. (-त्रं)
The string of a balance.
E.
तुला, and सूत्र thread.

f. (-लिः or -ली)
1 A fibrous stick or brush used by weavers for cleaning the threads of the woof.
2 A painter's brush, or fibrous stick used for that purpose: see तूलिका.
E.
तुल to resemble, &c. affix क, fem. affix इन् or ङीष्; also with ल changed to र, तुरि, तुरी.

f. (-लिः)
A painter's brush, or a fibrous stick used as one, and for other purposes.
E.
तूल to send forth or cut, affix इन्: see तूल and तूली.

f. (-का)
A small bird said to resemble the wagtail.

f. (-का)
1 A pencil, a painter's brush, or a stick with a fibrous extremity used as one.
2 A mattress^1 or quilt, a bed, a down or cotton bed.
3 An ingot mould.
4 A rod, &c. dipped into crucibles to try if their contents are in fusion.
5 A wick or twist of cotton either for a lamp or for applying unguents, &c.
E.
तूली as above, and कन् added.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Made equal or like, equalled, compared.
2 Weighed, counterpoised.
E.
तुल to weigh, क्त aff.

f. (-ला)
The Simul or silk cotton tree.
E.
तुलि for तूलि cotton, and फल fruit.

mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं)
Like, resembling, equal or analogous to.
E.
तुला resemblance, and यत् aff.

f. (-ता)
Likeness, sameness, equality.
E.
तल् added to the last; also with त्व, तुल्यत्वं.

n. (-नं)
Drinking together.
E.
तुल्य alike, and पान drinking.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Of equal strength.
E.
तुल्य, and बल strength.

n. (-नं)
Combination of like series, (in calculation.)
E.
तुल्य, and भावनं computing.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पी-पं)
1 Like, similar, analogous.
2 Of like or equal form.
E.
तुल्य, and रूप nature, &c.

mfn. (-त्तिः-त्तिः-त्ति)
Following the same or similar occupation.
E.
तुल्य, and वृत्ति business.

f. (-द्धिः)
Equal subtraction, transposition, (in Arithmetic.)
E.
तुल्य, and शुद्धि subtraction.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
Alike, of the same form.
E.
तुल्य, and आकृति form.

n. (-कं)
Cotton.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

n. (-कं)
A bow which is used for cleaning cotton.
E.
तूल cotton, and कार्म्मुक a bow; also similar compounds, as तूलचाप, तूलधनुः, &c.

f. (-ली)
A thick roll of cotton, from which it is drawn out in spinning.
E.
तूल cotton, नाल a tube, affixes अण् and ङीप्; also with कन् added तूलनालिका, f. (-का.)

m. (-चुः)
Cotton.
E.
तूल cotton, and पिचु the same.

f. (-रा)
A pod or seed of the plant, any seed yielding a similar substance.
E.
तूल cotton, and शर्करा sand or gravel.

n. (-नं)
Spinning.
E.
तूल cotton, सिच to sprinkle, and ल्युट् aff.

f. (-नी)
The silk cotton tree.
E.
तूल cotton, इनि and ङीष् aff.
